## The strategic overview {data-short-title="Strategic overview" .smaller}

```{r}
#| label: fig-strategy
#| echo: true
#| output-location: column
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-alt: "Three coloured strategy boxes connected by right-pointing arrows."

library(ggplot2)

strategy <- data.frame(
  x = c(1, 2.5, 4),
  y = 1,
  label = c(
    "People\nAsk them to\ndo more",
    "Process\nAdd a weekly\nmeeting",
    "Outcomes\nA colourful\ndashboard"
  ),
  stage = c("People", "Process", "Outcomes")
)

ggplot(strategy, aes(x, y)) +
  annotate(
    "segment", x = 1.55, xend = 1.95, y = 1, yend = 1,
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.15, "inches")),
    colour = "grey55", linewidth = 1
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment", x = 3.05, xend = 3.45, y = 1, yend = 1,
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.15, "inches")),
    colour = "grey55", linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_label(
    aes(label = label, fill = stage), colour = "white", size = 4,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0.5, "lines"), linewidth = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#9f2830", "#d26a50", "#595878")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.4, 4.6), ylim = c(0.6, 1.4), clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Growth remains strong {data-short-title="Growth remains strong" .smaller}

```{r}
#| label: fig-growth
#| echo: true
#| output-location: column
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-alt: "A red line chart showing strong growth over seven quarters."

growth <- data.frame(
  quarter = factor(
    c("Q1 25", "Q2 25", "Q3 25", "Q4 25", "Q1 26", "Q2 26", "Q3 26"),
    levels = c("Q1 25", "Q2 25", "Q3 25", "Q4 25", "Q1 26", "Q2 26", "Q3 26")
  ),
  value = c(8, 16, 13, 35, 30, 63, 92)
)

ggplot(growth, aes(quarter, value, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#b31f2b", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(colour = "#b31f2b", size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 50, 100),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = "*Axis adjusted until morale improved.") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

::: {.callout-important}

Selected metric*

## Key learnings {data-short-title="Key learnings"}

1. Mute Slack before sharing your entire desktop.
2. “Slide Show” is a button, not an aspiration.
3. Presenter View has two screens for a reason.
